comment: Bash commands taken from real spirits session logs, with the home directory, the account name, session ids, long hex runs, and mail addresses replaced. Every case is a command the guard classifies, and `expect` is the category id read from the spec for that shape: S1 shell control syntax or a function definition, S2 awk / jq / xargs, a sed that is not a line-range print, or a pipeline whose stages behind the first are not all allow-listed filters, S3 a heredoc written out to a file, P1 inline code in another language, P2 a non-TypeScript script under a temporary directory. Paths are read against the project working directory /work/project/spirits.

cases.command: for p in 292072 292075; do echo "=== $p status ==="; grep -E "^(Name|State|TracerPid|Pid|PPid|Threads|SigBlk|SigIgn|SigCgt|voluntary|nonvoluntary)" /proc/$p/status 2>&1; echo "--- wchan/syscall ---"; cat /proc/$p/wchan 2>&1; echo; cat /proc/$p/syscall 2>&1; echo "--- cwd ---"; ls -l /proc/$p/cwd 2>&1; done
for d in model-commands model-role-badge product-identity dual-model-routing; do echo "=== $d ==="; ls -la /work/project/spirits/openspec/specs/$d/ 2>&1; done
for f in phase router resolve register; do echo "=== $f.ts ==="; cat /work/project/spirits/packages/spirits/src/routing/$f.ts; done 2>&1

for f in /work/project/spirits_old/packages/ai/src/providers/data/xiaomi.json /work/project/spirits/packages/ai/dist/providers/data/xiaomi.json /work/project/spirits/packages/ai/src/providers/data/xiaomi.json; do echo "== $f"; ls -l --time-style=+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M "$f" 2>/dev/null; grep -o '"mimo-v[0-9.]*-[a-z]*"' "$f" 2>/dev/null | sort -u; done

ps -o pid,ppid,stat,args -p 606253 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; if ps -p 606253 >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 606253; echo killed; fi; sleep 0.3; ps -p 606253 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "still alive" || echo gone; echo "--- scopes ---"; systemctl --user list-units 'tmux-spawn-*' --state=active --no-pager 2>/dev/null | head

strace -f -o /tmp/strace-test.out sleep 300 & sp=$!; sleep 0.5; grep -E 'SigIgn|SigCgt' /proc/$sp/status; kill -HUP $sp; sleep 0.5; if kill -0 $sp 2>/dev/null; then echo "strace survived SIGHUP"; kill -9 $sp; else echo "strace died on SIGHUP"; fi; pkill -9 -f "sleep 300" 2>/dev/null; true

pid=$(pgrep -f "dist/spirits-linux-x64 --approve --model my_opencode/kimi-k3" | head -1); echo "pid=$pid"; if [ -n "$pid" ]; then tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$pid/environ | grep -c "^OPENCODE_API_KEY="; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$pid/environ | grep -o "^OPENCODE_API_KEY=.\{0,4\}"; fi

cd /work/project/spirits && ls openspec/specs/ && echo "=== main specs ===" && for d in architecture-guards bundled-skills sprt-opsx-review-change sprt-opsx-verify-deep; do f="openspec/specs/$d/spec.md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "--- EXISTS $f"; grep -n "^#\|^## \|^### Requirement" "$f" | head -30; else echo "--- MISSING $f"; fi; done
f() { printf "'%s'" "${1//\'/'\\''}"; }; f "a'b"; echo; f "plain"; echo; f "a b"; echo
pgrep -fa "tsc --noEmit" | grep -v grep; cat /tmp/verify2-tsc.log | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | tail -8; echo "TSC_LOG_END"

cd /work/project/spirits/packages/spirits && sed -i 's/import { dirname, join } from "node:path";/import { join } from "node:path";/' test/update-cleanup.test.ts && bun test test/update-cleanup.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -20

git log --oneline origin/main..spirits-m2-verify; echo "=== changes dir on origin/main ==="; git ls-tree -r --name-only origin/main openspec/changes | sed 's|/[^/]*$||' | sort -u; echo "=== changes dir current ==="; ls openspec/changes/
cd /work/project/spirits && gh run list --limit 6 2>&1; echo "=== CI failure annotation ==="; gh run view 3820352 2>&1 | sed -n '/ANNOTATIONS/,$p' | head -25

cd /work/project/spirits && echo "===UPSTREAM COMMITS BY TYPE===" && git log --oneline a276dabe5..FETCH_HEAD | sed -E 's/^[0-9a-f]+ //' | grep -oE '^[a-z]+(\([^)]*\))?' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -15 && echo && echo "===UPSTREAM TOP CHURNED coding-agent files===" && git diff --numstat a276dabe5..FETCH_HEAD -- packages/coding-agent/src | sort -rn | head -20

cd /work/project/spirits && sed 's|if run_case a "$a_cwd" "$WORK_DIR/a-agent" "$WORK_DIR/a-record.json"; then|if run_case a "$a_cwd" "$WORK_DIR/a-agent" "$WORK_DIR/a-record.json" SPIRITS_DOTENV_PROBE=1; then|' scripts/test-dotenv-smoke.sh > /tmp/neg-dotenv-test.sh && bash /tmp/neg-dotenv-test.sh dist/spirits-linux-x64; echo "exit=$?"; rm -f /tmp/neg-dotenv-test.sh
cat /tmp/s88-b-home/.spirits/agent/settings.json 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; env | grep -E '^(PI_|SPIRITS_|OPENROUTER|ANTHROPIC|OPENAI)' | sed 's/=.*/=<redacted>/' | sort
cd /work/project/spirits && grep -n "sleep 1" scripts/tmux-verify.sh && sed -n '/^	done$/,+2p' scripts/tmux-verify.sh | head

cd /work/project/spirits && echo "===UPSTREAM COMMITS touching root tooling===" && git log --oneline a276dabe5..FETCH_HEAD -- package.json biome.json tsconfig.json .npmrc | head -30 && echo && echo "===UPSTREAM new top-level dirs/files===" && git diff --name-status a276dabe5..FETCH_HEAD | awk '$1=="A"' | cut -d/ -f1-2 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -25

cat /proc/292072/io 2>&1; sleep 3; echo "--- after 3s ---"; cat /proc/292072/io 2>&1; echo "=== out file pos ==="; cat /proc/292072/fdinfo/3; echo "=== minflt ==="; awk '{print "minflt="$10" majflt="$12" nswap="$11}' /proc/292072/stat; awk '{print "minflt="$10" majflt="$12}' /proc/292075/stat
cd /work/project/spirits && awk 'NR<=141 {printf "%d: %s\n", NR, $0}' openspec/changes/harden-verification-cleanup/tasks.md | sed -n '86,114p'

cd /work/project/spirits && rg -n "spirits_skill_delete" openspec/specs/continual-harness/spec.md | head; echo "==="; awk '/### Requirement: .*delete/,/^### Requirement: [^d]/' openspec/specs/continual-harness/spec.md | head -40

cd /work/project/spirits && diff <(awk '/^### Requirement: スキルの保存$/,/^### Requirement: スキルの一覧$/' openspec/specs/continual-harness/spec.md | head -n -1) <(awk '/^### Requirement: スキルの保存$/,/^#### Scenario: 同梱ディレクトリへの symlink の拒否$/' openspec/changes/add-bundled-skills/specs/continual-harness/spec.md | head -n -1)

cd /work/project/spirits && find packages/spirits/src -name tsconfig.json | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {} ==="; cat {}' && echo '=== QuietStartup type ===' && rg -n 'QuietStartup' packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts | head -5 && rg -n 'export type QuietStartup' -A3 packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings.ts 2>/dev/null
lsof -ti:8899 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; setsid bash -c 'exec bun /tmp/mitm.mjs > /tmp/mitm.log 2>&1' < /dev/null & disown; sleep 1.5; cat /tmp/mitm.log

lsof -ti:8899 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; setsid bash -c 'exec bun /tmp/mitm.mjs > /tmp/mitm.log 2>&1' < /dev/null & disown; sleep 1.5; cat /tmp/mitm.log; echo '--- compiled help ---'; cd /work/project/spirits && ./dist/spirits-linux-x64 --help 2>&1 | rg -n 'spirits|Update pi|update \[' | head -8
cd /work/project/spirits && rg -n "truncateToWidth" packages/tui/src --glob '*.ts' | head; echo ---; find packages/tui/src -name "*.ts" | xargs rg -ln "truncateToWidth" | head

bash -n /tmp/test-spirits/_launch.sh && echo "syntax ok" && cat > /tmp/test-spirits/run-physical.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 物理モデルのまま起動する(バッジが出ないこと・振り分けが効かないことを確認する用)
SPIRITS_NO_AUTO_SELECT=1 exec "$(dirname "$0")/_launch.sh" strong "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/test-spirits/run-physical.sh && ls -la /tmp/test-spirits/*.sh
cd /work/project/spirits && openspec status --change "add-product-identity" --json 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print([(a['id'],a['status']) for a in d['artifacts']])"

cd /work/project/spirits && openspec instructions specs --change "add-product-identity" --json 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('OUTPUT:', d['outputPath']); print('INSTRUCTION:'); print(d['instruction']); print('TEMPLATE:'); print(d['template']); print('DEPS:', d.get('dependencies'))"

cd /work/project/spirits && openspec status --change "add-product-identity" --json 2>&1 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print([(a['id'],a['status']) for a in d['artifacts']]); print('complete:', d['isComplete'])"

cd /work/project/spirits && openspec status --change "add-self-update" --json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print([{a['id']: a['status']} for a in d['artifacts']]); print(d['nextSteps'])" && echo "=== validate help ===" && openspec validate --help 2>&1 | head -30

cd /work/project/spirits && openspec status --change "add-self-update" --json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print([{a['id']: a['status']} for a in d['artifacts']]); print('planningComplete:', d['isPlanningComplete'], 'complete:', d['isComplete'])" && echo "=== validate ===" && openspec validate add-self-update --strict --no-interactive 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /work/project/spirits && git status --short && echo "---" && find openspec/changes/add-self-update -type f | sort && echo "---" && openspec status --change add-self-update --json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f\"{a['id']}: {a['status']}\") for a in d['artifacts']]"

cd /work/project/spirits && rg -n "CONFIG_DIR_NAME|piConfig|APP_NAME" packages/coding-agent/test -g '*.ts' | head -20 && echo "---root pkg version---" && node -e "const p=require('./package.json');console.log('root',p.version);const c=require('./packages/coding-agent/package.json');console.log('coding-agent',c.version, JSON.stringify(c.piConfig))"
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,1)); console.log(p.workspaces)" && cat packages/spirits/package.json | head -40

openspec validate --strict add-product-identity && openspec instructions apply --change "add-product-identity" --json 2>/dev/null | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify(j.progress));console.log(j.tasks.filter(t=>!t.done).map(t=>t.id+': '+t.description.slice(0,60)).join('\n'))})"
cd /work/project/spirits && python3 /tmp/opsx-sync-add-self-update.py && echo "--- validate ---" && openspec validate --help 2>&1 | head -30
cd /work/project/spirits && python3 /tmp/opsx-verify-sync.py && echo "=== validate all strict ===" && openspec validate --all --strict --no-interactive 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /work/project/spirits && node /tmp/apitest/gen-fixtures.mjs && find packages/spirits/test/fixtures/architecture -type f | wc -l && ls packages/spirits/test/fixtures/architecture/
cd /work/project/spirits && node /tmp/verify-sync.mjs
